critical_code_review_comments: CompleteReport.jsx empty-state renders TWO identical buttons (complete-empty-assessment-btn + complete-empty-joint-btn) both linking to /joint/new with the same label 'Create a Joint Report' — the first button (Plus icon) is likely a leftover from when private assessments existed; consider removing complete-empty-assessment-btn or repurposing it to open the sacoparentsapp.online link flow / hub.

Dashboard.jsx line 174: linkCode is uppercased on input but the button enables at length >= 6 (maxLength=8). The spec calls for an 8-char code; consider enforcing linkCode.trim().length === 8 to match sacoparentsapp.online link-code format.

Dashboard.jsx line 33 loads /external/link on every mount even for freshly registered users — fine, but on failure it optimistically sets {linked:false} which silently masks unrelated 5xx errors; consider distinguishing network errors from 'not linked' state.
No regression risk found from the Landing/Dashboard edits on the previously-verified agreement + pro-request + safety flows (Dashboard cards for those flows still present and unchanged).
